skill.name: create-svg-from-prompt
skill.description: Generate SVG artwork from a text prompt by requesting a Gemini image and tracing it with autotrace.
skill.summary: Creates prompt-based SVG files through Gemini image generation and autotrace conversion.
skill.author: 0x6a77

security_audit.summary: The skill performs the advertised SVG generation workflow, but it requires privileged package installation, an unpinned source build, external API calls, and access to a Gemini API key. Several Ruby backtick detections are Markdown formatting false positives, but the sudo, network, credential, and shell-pipeline risks are real.

remediation.issue: Privileged host installation is required during setup.
remediation.suggestion: Remove sudo setup steps from the skill workflow, or require users to install audited dependencies separately before invoking the skill.

remediation.issue: The setup builds and installs unpinned source from GitHub.
remediation.suggestion: Pin autotrace to a trusted release or commit and verify checksums or signatures before any local build or installation.

remediation.issue: The Gemini API key is passed through a shell curl command.
remediation.suggestion: Use a safer API client or documented secret handling path that avoids exposing credentials in command history, process listings, or logs.

remediation.issue: The user prompt is interpolated into shell-quoted JSON.
remediation.suggestion: Construct request bodies with a JSON encoder and pass command arguments without shell interpretation.

remediation.issue: User prompt content is sent to an external Google API.
remediation.suggestion: Document the external transmission clearly and require user confirmation before sending sensitive prompt content.

content.user_title: Create SVG Artwork from Text Prompts
content.value_statement: Designers and developers often need quick vector artwork from a written idea. This skill generates an image with Gemini, traces it, and saves an SVG file.
actual_capabilities: Creates SVG files from text descriptions of images or scenes.
Uses Gemini image generation as the raster image source.
Converts generated image data into SVG output with autotrace.
Names the output file from the requested image subject.
Provides setup commands for installing autotrace when missing.
limitations: Requires a valid Gemini API key in the local environment.
Requires autotrace and related native build dependencies.
May produce imperfect vector traces from complex or detailed images.
Sends prompt content to Google Generative Language API.

use_cases.title: Prototype Interface Illustrations
use_cases.description: Generate small SVG illustrations for product mockups, empty states, or documentation pages.

use_cases.title: Create Lightweight Web Assets
use_cases.description: Turn simple visual ideas into SVG files that can be edited or embedded in web projects.

use_cases.title: Draft Visual Concepts Quickly
use_cases.description: Produce editable vector drafts before investing time in manual illustration work.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Icon
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a basic visual asset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an SVG of a simple line icon showing a calendar with a check mark.

prompt_templates.title: Product Illustration
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a reusable illustration for an interface section.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an SVG of a clean dashboard illustration with charts, a task list, and a small success indicator.

prompt_templates.title: Style-Controlled Scene
prompt_templates.scenario: Request a specific visual style and composition.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an SVG of a flat vector scene showing a mobile developer testing an app, using clear shapes and limited colors.

prompt_templates.title: Asset With Constraints
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with target use and output constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an SVG hero illustration for a security report page, with a shield, document marks, and restrained professional colors.

output_examples.input: Generate an SVG of a small rocket launching from a laptop.
output_examples.output: A rocket-themed SVG asset saved with a descriptive filename for web or document use.

output_examples.input: Generate an SVG of a simple onboarding checklist illustration.
output_examples.output: An editable vector illustration showing checklist items, progress, and a clean onboarding theme.

output_examples.input: Generate an SVG of a cloud database with sync arrows.
output_examples.output: A traced SVG concept asset suitable for technical documentation or a dashboard empty state.

best_practices: Use concise prompts with clear subjects, style, and intended use.
Avoid sensitive or private details because prompts are sent to an external API.
Review and optimize the resulting SVG before production use.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for confidential visual concepts without approval.
Do not expect precise brand compliance from a generated and traced image.
Do not run setup commands on shared systems without reviewing them first.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates SVG files from text prompts by generating an image and tracing it into vector form.

faq.question: Does it need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow expects a Gemini API key available through the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.

faq.question: Does it work without network access?
faq.answer: No. It calls the Google Generative Language API to create the source image.

faq.question: Can the SVG be edited later?
faq.answer: Yes. The output is an SVG file, but traced shapes may need cleanup in a vector editor.

faq.question: Is this suitable for exact logos?
faq.answer: It is better for draft illustrations and simple assets than exact brand marks or production logos.

faq.question: What should users review before running it?
faq.answer: Users should review setup commands, external API use, API key handling, and the generated SVG output.
